'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2024 Israeli military operation in the northern West Bank]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] launch a major [[military operation]] in the [[West Bank]], primarily in the cities of [[Jenin]] and [[Tulkarm]], with at least ten [[Palestinians]] killed and several others injured. The Al-Israa Specialised Hospital and the Thabet Thabet Governmental Hospital are surrounded, and ambulances are blocked from entering the hospitals. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/28/israels-war-on-gaza-live-many-still-buried-after-day-of-israeli-strikes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] strike an [[oil terminal]] in [[Kamensky District, Rostov Oblast|Kamensky District]], [[Rostov Oblast]], [[Russia]], causing a large fire. [[Ukraine]] also launches [[drone warfare|drone attack]]s on [[Kirov Oblast]] for the first time, striking an oil depot in [[Kotelnich]]. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says that air defences have shot down eight drones over [[Voronezh Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-drones-set-oil-depot-russias-rostov-ablaze-russian-telegram-channels-2024-08-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Las Anod conflict (2023–present)|Las Anod conflict]]
***At least nine people are killed in fighting between [[SSC-Khatumo]] forces and [[Somaliland]] troops near [[Erigavo]], [[Sanaag]], Somaliland. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/fresh-fighting-in-northern-somalia-leaves-5-dead (Garowe Online)] [https://www.bbc.com/somali/articles/cq82447yz54o (BBC News Somali)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Three [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad|Islamic Jihad Palestinian fighters]] and a [[Hezbollah]] militant are killed in an [[Israel]]i drone strike on a vehicle at a [[Border checkpoint|checkpoint]] on the [[Lebanon–Syria border]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/28/israels-war-on-gaza-live-many-still-buried-after-day-of-israeli-strikes?update=3145614 (Al Jazeera)]

*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Tatmadaw]] forces launch a major [[counterattack|counteroffensive]] against rebels in [[Kachin State]], [[Myanmar]], following the fall of [[Momauk]] to the [[Kachin Independence Army]]. [https://myanmar-now.org/en/news/myanmar-junta-launches-major-counteroffensive-in-southern-kachin-state/ (Myanmar Now)]
**A [[United Nations|UN]] official says that the [[Arakan Army]] has begun indiscriminately attacking the [[Islam in Myanmar|Muslim]] [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] minority in [[Rakhine State]] after capturing much of the state, forcing thousands of people to flee. The rebel group is reportedly "rounding up groups" of Rohingya men and [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] Rohingya villages. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/article/2024/aug/22/myanmar-rohingya-muslim-minority-flee-bangladesh-massacres-arakan-army-rebels (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Sudan floods]]
**[[Arbaat Dam collapse]]
***The death toll from flooding across Sudan including the collapse of the Arbaat Dam near [[Port Sudan]], [[Sudan]], increases to 148 people. [https://sudantribune.com/article290115/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Hundreds of flights are cancelled and the [[Japan Meteorological Agency]] issues an alert in [[Kagoshima Prefecture]] as [[Typhoon Shanshan (2024)|Typhoon Shanshan]] is expected to make landfall over southwestern [[Japan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/japan/japan-braces-typhoon-shanshan-heavy-rain-strong-winds-forecast-2024-08-28/ (Reuters)]
**Three people are injured and three others are reported missing due to heavy rains and landslides in [[Kyushu]], according to the [[Fire and Disaster Management Agency]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/weather/topstories/three-missing-after-typhoon-shanshan-brings-heavy-rain-to-japan/ar-AA1pzBOZ (MSN)]
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan floods]]
**The death toll from flooding in [[Pakistan]] increases to 245 people. [https://dunyanews.tv/en/Pakistan/833686-rains-floods-claim-245-lives-in-27-days-ndma- (Dunya News)]
*[[2024 Yemen floods]]
**At least 33 people are killed by landslides and heavy rainfall in [[Al Mahwit]], [[Yemen]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2534887-tientallen-doden-door-noodweer-en-aardverschuivingen-in-jemen (NOS)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–United States relations]], [[Israeli settler violence]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] imposes sanctions on [[Israeli settler]] group Hashomer Yosh and a civilian security coordinator for the [[Yitzhar]] settlement for [[extremist]] [[Israeli settler violence|settler violence]] against Palestinians in the West Bank. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/28/us-issues-more-sanctions-over-israeli-settler-violence-in-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]]
***[[Haitian National Police]] and [[Kenya Police]], along with other foreign police forces as part of the [[Multinational Security Support Mission in Haiti]], launch a joint operation to oust violent gangs from parts of the [[Haiti]]an capital city [[Port-au-Prince]]. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-gangs-police-military-kenyans-shooting-ad2ffb474743ad035974e81bc5c0e87e (AP)]
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**The [[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[Federal Criminal Court of Switzerland|Federal Criminal Court]] convicts two PetroSaudi executives to six and seven years in prison respectively for embezzling more than US$1.8 billion from the [[Malaysia]]n [[business development|strategic development]] firm [[1Malaysia Development Berhad]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/28/swiss-court-convicts-two-executives-of-embezzling-1-8bn-from-1mdb (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Quran burnings in Sweden]]
**[[Sweden|Swedish]] prosecutors charge [[Salwan Momika]] and Salwan Najem with four counts of "[[Incitement to ethnic or racial hatred#Sweden|offences of agitation against an ethnic or national group]]" after the two [[Quran desecration|desecrated]] the [[Quran]] and made derogatory remarks about [[Muslim]]s in [[Stockholm]] last year. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/28/sweden-charges-men-over-2023-quran-burnings-condemned-by-muslim-countries (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Arrest of Pavel Durov]]
**[[Government of France|French]] prosecutors formally [[Indictment|indict]] [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Pavel Durov]] with [[complicity]] in distribution of [[child exploitation]] media and [[Illegal drug trade|drug trafficking]] and ban him from leaving [[France]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-08-28/telegram-ceo-charged-in-france-for-alleged-criminal-use-of-app?embedded-checkout=true (Bloomberg)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[LXVI Legislature of the Mexican Congress]]
**Two [[Senate of the Republic (Mexico)|senators]] elected from the defunct [[Party of the Democratic Revolution]] (PRD) in [[Mexico]] defect to the ruling [[National Regeneration Movement|Morena]] party, leaving Morena and its allies one seat short of a [[supermajority]] in both chambers of [[Congress (Mexico)|Congress]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-senate-congress-ruling-party-majority-8564bc2307ed3aa6b2750eaf125384a5 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] announces discovery of [[Earth]]'s [[ambipolar electric field|subtle electric field]], which contributes to the [[polar wind]] phenomenon. Its significance as to the [[history of life|emergence of life]] and [[multicellular organism|complex organism]]s on Earth, and the planet's physical and chemical properties, are to be analyzed. [https://science.nasa.gov/science-research/heliophysics/nasa-discovers-long-sought-global-electric-field-on-earth/ (NASA Science)] [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/nasa-reveals-earths-hidden-electric-field-that-creates-supersonic-wind/ar-AA1pE4JF (MSN, Newsweek)]
*The U.S. [[Federal Aviation Administration]] temporarily grounds all [[SpaceX]] [[Falcon 9]] launches and orders an investigation following a [[booster (rocketry)|booster rocket]] fire incident at the [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station]] in [[Florida]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/spacex-launch-accident-booster-db396897fbb90d00ef18be886b3b1ce0 (AP)]
